heading: INT. ORBITAL HOSTEL - GALLEY - NIGHT CYCLE

units.text: INT. ORBITAL HOSTEL - GALLEY - NIGHT CYCLE
A narrow galley under dim amber light.
A foldable table.
Pouches of food clipped to a rail.
Through a porthole, the slow curve of a blue planet.
A WOMAN (30s, grey coverall, wrist tattoo) sits alone at the table, peeling the foil off a ration tray.
She eats a small bite, looks at the porthole, eats another.
CASS (30s, medic jacket, bleary) floats in and anchors himself to a rail with his foot.
You're up.
units.name: CASS

units.text: You're up.
units.name: WOMAN

units.text: I couldn't sleep.
units.name: CASS

units.text: Me neither.
units.name: WOMAN

units.text: He fills a squeeze bulb at the dispenser, drinks, wipes his mouth.
Looks at her tray.
Is that the chicken?
units.name: CASS

units.text: Allegedly.
units.name: WOMAN

units.text: HOWARD (60s, station steward, clipboard, a bad hip) enters, slow.
He sees the Woman, stops.
Dr. Devi. I didn't know you'd come down.
units.name: HOWARD

units.text: Neither did I, Howard.
units.name: DEVI

units.text: He nods, studies her, glances at Cass.
Cass takes another sip.
Howard consults his clipboard.
The log says you're in quarantine.
units.name: HOWARD

units.text: The log is early.
units.name: DEVI

units.text: I'll note it.
units.name: HOWARD

units.text: Note whatever you like.
units.name: DEVI

units.text: Howard hesitates, then marks a line and shuffles out.
Cass and Devi sit in the quiet.
The planet turns outside.
You told them you were fine?
units.name: CASS

units.text: I told them I was awake.
units.name: DEVI
